data.title: 1H 2023 Transparency Report Statistics
data.content:
The number of requests that Daum and Kakao received from the government for communication data has increased approximately twice and decreased 32.6%, respectively, compared to the second half of 2022. Kakao has not provided communication data since the first half of 2013.
In response to requests for data on communication-restricting measures in Daum services, only data that strictly pertain to standards are provided after thorough review is conducted in accordance to relevant legislations. We do not provide any data on communication-restricting measures that pertain to Kakao services.
The number of requests for communication confirmation data and processed requests related to Daum services has decreased slightly over the same period compared to the second half of 2022. Meanwhile, the number of requests and processed requests related to Kakao services has increased slightly over the same period.
Requests for search and seizure warrants related to Daum services have decreased by 7.9%, while those for Kakao services have increased by 4.7% compared to the second half of 2022.
The number of accounts processed in response to search and seizure warrants related to Daum services has decreased by 84.8%, while those related to Kakao services has increased 48.9% compared to the second half of 2022. Kakao strives to provide only the minimum information necessary to meet the requirements.
